name: base_reversal_5d
hypothesis: Hand-written baseline: 5-day short-term reversal

name: base_momentum_60d
hypothesis: Hand-written baseline: 3-month momentum, skipping the most recent week

name: base_low_vol_20d
hypothesis: Hand-written baseline: low volatility

name: base_volume_shock
hypothesis: Hand-written baseline: avoid volume spikes

name: g1_smooth_reversal
hypothesis: Baseline reversal has IC>0 but turnover of 78x/year. Smooth it with a 10-day weighted average to cut turnover while keeping the reversal signal.

name: g1_pv_divergence
hypothesis: Price and volume rising together (positive correlation) is usually the crowd chasing price -> reversal; negative correlation means accumulation.

name: g1_close_location
hypothesis: Closing near the day's high repeatedly over many days = aggressive buying / institutional accumulation.

name: g1_liquidity
hypothesis: Highly liquid VN30 names are favoured by foreign investors and ETFs -> steadier money flow.

name: g1_near_high
hypothesis: 52-week-high anchoring (George & Hwang): investors under-react to good news for stocks near their high -> they keep rising.

name: g1_amihud
hypothesis: Illiquidity premium (Amihud): less liquid stocks require higher expected returns.

name: g1_overnight_rev
hypothesis: Retail investors place emotional ATO orders -> persistently positive opening gaps are overshooting and will reverse.

name: g1_neg_skew
hypothesis: 'Lottery' stocks (right-skewed returns) are overpriced by retail buyers -> lower future returns.

name: g2_pv_div_20
hypothesis: Window mutation of pv_divergence (10->20) to test parameter robustness and reduce turnover.

name: g2_pv_div_smooth
hypothesis: pv_divergence is the best but turnover is 57x/year -> smooth the signal over 5 days.
error: ValueError: coverage only 50% -> too many NaN

name: g2_ret_vol_corr
hypothesis: Variant using returns instead of price level: price rising on a volume spike = FOMO -> reversal.

name: g2_near_high_120
hypothesis: Mutation of near_high using the 6-month high instead of the 12-month high.

name: g2_high_x_div
hypothesis: Crossover of the 2 leading alphas, which have low correlation with each other -> add their ranks to diversify.

name: g2_high_x_skew
hypothesis: Near the high but not a 'lottery' stock: filter out overheated names.

name: g2_money_flow
expr: rank(ts_sum((2 * close - high - low) / (high - low + 1e-9 * close) * volume, 10) / ts_sum(volume, 10))
hypothesis: Volume-weighted close location (Chaikin money flow style): only high-volume days closing high matter.

name: g2_overnight_mom
hypothesis: overnight_rev has negative IC -> flip the sign: sustained positive opening gaps are good news being absorbed.

name: g3_pv_div_mean
hypothesis: Fix for gen2: decay_linear does not tolerate NaN -> use ts_mean (flexible min_periods) to smooth pv_divergence and reduce turnover.

name: g3_triple
hypothesis: Combine 3 weakly correlated signal sources: high anchoring, price-volume divergence, avoiding lottery stocks.

name: g3_high_x_div_smooth
hypothesis: high_x_div with a smoothed divergence component -> expect turnover to drop from 45x to ~30x.

name: g3_risk_adj_mom
hypothesis: Risk-adjusted momentum (trend quality): steady trends persist longer than jumpy ones.

name: g3_vol_dryup
hypothesis: Volume drying up = selling pressure exhausted; exploding volume = short-term top.

name: g3_pullback_in_trend
hypothesis: A stock near its yearly high that just pulled back short-term = a buy point in an uptrend (interaction, not a sum).

name: g3_vwap_div
hypothesis: Replace close with the session average price to reduce ATC (closing auction) noise.

name: g3_high_dist_slow
hypothesis: near_high with a 5-day smoothed price -> same signal, lower turnover.

name: g4_triple_smooth
hypothesis: triple leads but turnover is 45x. Replace 2 components with the smoothed versions shown to cut turnover in gen3.

name: g4_triple_w
hypothesis: near_high is the most stable and cheapest (low turnover) component -> double its weight.

name: g4_max_effect
hypothesis: MAX effect (Bali 2011): stocks with a recent limit-up day attract retail investors -> overpriced. Looking for a signal orthogonal to near_high.

name: g4_low_beta
hypothesis: Low-beta anomaly: stocks that move less with the market earn higher risk-adjusted returns. (returns - demean(returns) = the basket's average return).

name: g4_range_compress
hypothesis: A narrowing daily range (volatility compression) often precedes a breakout in the direction of the main trend.

name: g4_up_volume_share
hypothesis: Share of volume on up days = accumulation; differs from pv_divergence because it uses the sign of returns, not the price level.

name: g4_high_skew_slow
hypothesis: high_x_skew has the lowest turnover among the leaders -> smooth both legs further, aiming for a 'cheap' alpha.

name: g4_quad
expr: rank(ts_mean(close, 5) / ts_max(close, 250)) + rank(-ts_corr(rank(close), rank(volume), 10)) + rank(-ts_skew(returns, 60)) + rank(-ts_max(returns, 20))
hypothesis: Add the MAX effect to triple as a 4th component (a bet placed before seeing its standalone result, for comparison).

name: g5_high_beta
hypothesis: low_beta has t=-2.65 -> flip the sign. The Vietnamese market is retail-driven, and high-beta stocks (brokers, banks) lead rallies. Warning: this is a cyclical bet that breaks easily in a falling market.

name: g5_triple_upvol
expr: 2 * rank(ts_mean(close, 5) / ts_max(close, 250)) + rank(-ts_corr(rank(close), rank(volume), 10)) + rank(-ts_skew(returns, 60)) + rank(ts_sum(where(returns > 0, volume, volume * 0), 20) / ts_sum(volume, 20))
hypothesis: Add up_volume_share (orthogonal, corr 0.27) to the leading triple_w.

name: g5_upvol_40
hypothesis: Test the parameter robustness of up_volume_share (20->40) and reduce turnover.

name: g5_slow_core
expr: 2 * rank(ts_mean(close, 5) / ts_max(close, 250)) + rank(-ts_skew(returns, 120)) + rank(ts_sum(where(returns > 0, volume, volume * 0), 40) / ts_sum(volume, 40))
hypothesis: A 'cheap' version: keep only the slow (low-turnover) components so the alpha survives fees.

name: g5_beta_x_high
hypothesis: High beta + near the high: rally leaders that are currently strong.

name: g5_frog_in_pan
hypothesis: Frog-in-the-pan (Da, Gurun & Warachka): momentum built from many small up days persists longer than momentum from a few jumps.

name: g5_two_volume
expr: rank(-ts_corr(rank(close), rank(volume), 10)) + rank(ts_sum(where(returns > 0, volume, volume * 0), 20) / ts_sum(volume, 20))
hypothesis: Two money-flow signals with different mechanisms (price-level divergence vs signed volume) -> combine them.

name: g5_triple_upvol_beta
expr: 2 * rank(ts_mean(close, 5) / ts_max(close, 250)) + rank(-ts_corr(rank(close), rank(volume), 10)) + rank(-ts_skew(returns, 60)) + rank(ts_sum(where(returns > 0, volume, volume * 0), 20) / ts_sum(volume, 20)) + rank(ts_corr(returns, returns - demean(returns), 60))
hypothesis: Add beta as a 5th component; compare with g5_triple_upvol to measure how much beta contributes.

name: g6_beta120_x_high
hypothesis: Robustness check: beta measured over 120 days instead of 60. If the t-stat collapses, beta_x_high is a lucky parameter.

name: g6_beta_slope_x_high
expr: rank(ts_corr(returns, returns - demean(returns), 60) * ts_std(returns, 60) / ts_std(returns - demean(returns), 60)) + rank(ts_mean(close, 5) / ts_max(close, 250))
hypothesis: Use proper beta (regression slope = corr x sigma_i / sigma_m) instead of just the correlation.

name: g6_beta_high_upvol
expr: rank(ts_corr(returns, returns - demean(returns), 60)) + rank(ts_mean(close, 5) / ts_max(close, 250)) + rank(ts_sum(where(returns > 0, volume, volume * 0), 20) / ts_sum(volume, 20))
hypothesis: beta_x_high (low turnover) + up_volume_share (orthogonal).

name: g6_no_skew
expr: 2 * rank(ts_mean(close, 5) / ts_max(close, 250)) + rank(-ts_corr(rank(close), rank(volume), 10)) + rank(ts_sum(where(returns > 0, volume, volume * 0), 20) / ts_sum(volume, 20)) + rank(ts_corr(returns, returns - demean(returns), 60))
hypothesis: Ablation: drop the skew component from the leading alpha to measure its real contribution.

name: g6_beta_high_div
expr: rank(ts_corr(returns, returns - demean(returns), 60)) + rank(ts_mean(close, 5) / ts_max(close, 250)) + rank(-ts_corr(rank(close), rank(volume), 10))
hypothesis: beta_x_high + price-volume divergence.

name: g6_beta_times_high
hypothesis: Multiplicative form (interaction): only pick stocks that are BOTH high beta AND near their high, instead of adding.

name: g6_low_idio_vol
hypothesis: Low idiosyncratic volatility anomaly (Ang et al.): retail investors overpay for volatility that does not come from the market.

name: g6_attention
hypothesis: Gradually rising traded value (money/attention returning) signals a new rally.

name: g7_bhd_smooth
expr: rank(ts_corr(returns, returns - demean(returns), 60)) + rank(ts_mean(close, 5) / ts_max(close, 250)) + rank(ts_mean(-ts_corr(rank(close), rank(volume), 10), 5))
hypothesis: beta_high_div leads on IC but its 45x turnover eats all the profit -> smooth the divergence (fastest) component.

name: g7_bhd_skew
expr: rank(ts_corr(returns, returns - demean(returns), 60)) + rank(ts_mean(close, 5) / ts_max(close, 250)) + rank(-ts_corr(rank(close), rank(volume), 10)) + rank(-ts_skew(returns, 60))
hypothesis: The gen6 ablation showed skew contributes -> add it to beta_high_div.

name: g7_bhd_upvol
expr: rank(ts_corr(returns, returns - demean(returns), 60)) + rank(ts_mean(close, 5) / ts_max(close, 250)) + rank(-ts_corr(rank(close), rank(volume), 10)) + rank(ts_sum(where(returns > 0, volume, volume * 0), 20) / ts_sum(volume, 20))
hypothesis: beta_high_upvol has the highest excess return (+11.4%) -> add the divergence component.

name: g7_bh_held
hypothesis: Smooth all of beta_x_high over 10 days: target turnover < 12x/year.

name: g7_bh_lowidio
expr: rank(ts_corr(returns, returns - demean(returns), 60)) + rank(ts_mean(close, 5) / ts_max(close, 250)) + rank(-ts_std(demean(returns), 60))
hypothesis: High beta but low idiosyncratic volatility: risk comes from the market (compensated), not from stock-specific risk (not compensated).

name: g7_intraday_mom
hypothesis: Tug of war (Lou, Polk & Skouras): intraday returns reflect institutions, overnight returns reflect retail -> intraday momentum persists longer.

name: g7_stable_volume
hypothesis: Stable volume = long-term institutional holders; erratic volume = speculation.

name: g7_six
expr: rank(ts_corr(returns, returns - demean(returns), 60)) + 2 * rank(ts_mean(close, 5) / ts_max(close, 250)) + rank(ts_mean(-ts_corr(rank(close), rank(volume), 10), 5)) + rank(-ts_skew(returns, 60)) + rank(ts_sum(where(returns > 0, volume, volume * 0), 20) / ts_sum(volume, 20))
hypothesis: Combine every component shown to contribute, with the smoothed divergence.

name: g8_bh_intraday
expr: rank(ts_corr(returns, returns - demean(returns), 60)) + rank(ts_mean(close, 5) / ts_max(close, 250)) + rank(ts_mean(close / open - 1, 20))
hypothesis: intraday_mom is orthogonal (corr 0.34) and beats the basket by +9.2% -> combine it with the beta_x_high core.

name: g8_bhd_intraday
expr: rank(ts_corr(returns, returns - demean(returns), 60)) + rank(ts_mean(close, 5) / ts_max(close, 250)) + rank(-ts_corr(rank(close), rank(volume), 10)) + rank(ts_mean(close / open - 1, 20))
hypothesis: Leading alpha (beta_high_div) + intraday_mom.

name: g8_tug_of_war
hypothesis: Intraday minus overnight return: directly measures the 'tug of war' between institutions and retail.

name: g8_intraday_40
hypothesis: Test the parameter robustness of intraday_mom (20->40).

name: g8_stable_x_high
hypothesis: stable_volume is almost uncorrelated with the elite (0.08) -> try it as a diversifying component.

name: g8_bhd_w
expr: 2 * rank(ts_corr(returns, returns - demean(returns), 60)) + 2 * rank(ts_mean(close, 5) / ts_max(close, 250)) + rank(-ts_corr(rank(close), rank(volume), 10))
hypothesis: Increase the weight of the two slow components to cut the turnover of beta_high_div while keeping its IC.

name: g8_seven
expr: rank(ts_corr(returns, returns - demean(returns), 60)) + 2 * rank(ts_mean(close, 5) / ts_max(close, 250)) + rank(ts_mean(-ts_corr(rank(close), rank(volume), 10), 5)) + rank(-ts_skew(returns, 60)) + rank(ts_sum(where(returns > 0, volume, volume * 0), 20) / ts_sum(volume, 20)) + rank(ts_mean(close / open - 1, 20))
hypothesis: g7_six + intraday_mom.

name: g8_bh_intra_held
expr: rank(ts_mean(rank(ts_corr(returns, returns - demean(returns), 60)) + rank(ts_mean(close, 5) / ts_max(close, 250)) + rank(ts_mean(close / open - 1, 20)), 10))
hypothesis: 10-day smoothed version of g8_bh_intraday for low turnover.
